title: Correct first fringe distance
description: Essential: The answer for part (1) must be y = λL/(8d).

title: Correct modified fringe distance
description: Essential: The answer for part (2) must include the floor function and be equivalent to y = (L/(4d))[(n-1)s - λ⌊(n-1)s/λ - 1/2⌋ - λ/2].

title: Correct total fringe count
description: Essential: The answer for part (3) must be the integer nearest to 2 * (2d/λ)(1 - 2/√5).

title: Path difference derivation
description: Important: The solution must correctly derive the path difference for the right wall as Δr ≈ 4dy/L + λ/2, accounting for the π phase shift.

title: Shell optical path treatment
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must correctly add the extra optical path (n-1)s for the direct ray and not for the reflected ray.

title: Top wall geometry setup
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must set up the path difference on the top wall using the correct geometry and the π phase shift.

title: Use of small-angle approximations
description: Optional: The solution correctly applies approximations like λ << y << L and d << L to simplify square roots or trigonometric relations.

title: Sign error in phase shift
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly adding or omitting the λ/2 term from the mirror's 180° phase change in the path difference.

title: Misapplication of floor function
description: Pitfall: In part (2), incorrectly determining the integer m for the closest fringe, e.g., not using the floor function as specified.

title: Unit or dimensional inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Final answers lack correct units or have dimensional inconsistencies from incorrect algebraic manipulation.
